articles.title: Scarborough Busway set to open on Sept. 30
articles.summary: More than six months ahead of schedule, the Scarborough Busway is set to open on Sept. 30. The four-kilometre busway will operate between Kennedy and Ellesmere stations then connect to Scarborough Town Centre through Ellesmere Road’s priority bus infrastructure. articles.title: Recently resigned Liberal MP runs for city council in Scarborough North
articles.summary: Recently resigned Liberal MP Shaun Chen is throwing his hat in for a Toronto city council position.

articles.title: Second overnight shooting reported in Rexdale neighbourhood this week
articles.summary: Officers were called to the area of Upper Humber Drive near Finch Avenue West at 3:44 a.m. Thursday after residents reported the sound of gunshots.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after crash in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A man has died in hospital after a motorcycle crash in Scarborough Wednesday evening, police said.

articles.title: Toronto councillor Paula Fletcher announces retirement from municipal politics
articles.summary: Toronto city councillor Paula Fletcher says she is retiring from city hall and will not seek re-election in the October municipal election.

articles.title: Botched opening day of Markham Indy race forces race president to apologize
articles.summary: The president of the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham is proud of how the event came together, but he's sorry that most fans went home disappointed after the event's opening day.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after crash with transit bus in Brampton, police say
articles.summary: A 50-year-old motorcyclist is dead after a crash in Brampton Wednesday morning, police said.

articles.title: Former Liberal MP Nate Erskine-Smith to run for council seat in Beaches-East York
articles.summary: Former Liberal MP Nate Erskine-Smith will run for a Toronto city council seat in Beaches-East York in the October municipal election.

articles.title: Family of toddler who died in fall from North York highrise sues building owners, management
articles.summary: The family of a toddler who fell to her death from a highrise apartment in North York in May is suing the building owners and its management for millions in damages.
